provenance_data_source.notes: All normalization thresholds and horizon parameters derived exclusively from 2022 validation distribution.

mathematical_specification.planning_formula: planning_solar_w = min(F_w, (1.0 - lambda_t) * F_w + lambda_t * q10_w)

uncertainty_component.derivation_rationale: Derived from 2022 validation daytime relative interval width distribution where 20th percentile is ~0.18 and 80th percentile is ~0.71.

horizon_component.derivation_rationale: On 2022 validation data, MAE at h=1 is 5.48 W/m2, rising to 64.88 W/m2 by h=12. Near-term forecasts have high sensor persistence and can tolerate lower conservatism.

operational_relevance_gate.derivation_rationale: When anticipated wind generation covers 100% of critical load, solar uncertainty cannot cause an unserved energy deficit in that hour, so conservatism is deactivated to avoid burning diesel.

ordering_and_boundary_rules.ordering_handling: If q10_w > F_w, planning_solar_w = F_w (never inflates above point forecast)
ordering_and_boundary_rules.interval_bounds: q10_w <= planning_solar_w <= F_w when q10_w <= F_w

comparison_arms.arm_b: ARM_B_STATIC_Q10 (Static calibrated q10 lower bound from L2-EXP-07)
